protocol.hypothesis: Class-balanced fitting can improve limited-capacity boundaries compared with fitting unbalanced then dividing priors. No post-hoc threshold search.
protocol.gate: Both seeds delta > 0.001 and paired 95% CI lower > 0
protocol.compute: Two linear convex classifiers; reuse phase3 validation runner and prior feature factory. No trees or threshold search. Stop if screening delta <= .001.
protocol.history: Sequential research after phase1/2 and phase3 exploratory results; no independent blind validation or measured Kaggle score.
